title: Remake History and the Northgate Optical Accidental Replacement Percentage: Decision Table
content:
A Northgate Optical job on which the member has already paid for remakes receives a lower replacement percentage on an accidental damage replacement.

**Rule.** Where the remake charges booked on the job, less every waiver posted against them, total at least 50.00, the replacement percentage is lowered by 10 percentage points, and where they total at least 25.00 but less than 50.00, it is lowered by 5 percentage points. Below 25.00 there is no lowering.

**The total read.** All remake charge entries on the job, whatever their reason, added together, less every remake charge waiver credit posted on the job. An entry of 0.00 adds nothing.

## Decision table

| Remake charges on the job, net of waivers | Lowering of the replacement percentage |
|---|---|
| less than 25.00 | none |
| 25.00 up to but not including 50.00 | 5 percentage points |
| 50.00 or more | 10 percentage points |

## Worked lines (hypothetical jobs)

| Remake charges booked | Waivers posted | Net | Lowering |
|---|---|---|---|
| 79.99 | 10.04 | 69.95 | 10 points |
| 59.99 | 10.00 | 49.99 | 5 points |
| 30.00 and 0.00 | none | 30.00 | 5 points |
| 69.95 | 69.95 | 0.00 | none |

A lowering is a reduction in percentage points: a replacement percentage of 25 percent lowered by 5 points is 20 percent.
